html: Schema 0.3. Every graded cell now carries an evidence state (assessed, assessed_absent, not_assessed, not_applicable), the rubric version it was graded under, the date its literature was last searched, the date its grade was last confirmed by a rater, and a review-due flag. Grading rubric v1.0 published and linked from every cell. Licence figures replaced by a licence class for employer or vendor use, with archived copies of steward pages linked on each record. Single-rater disclosure recorded in the dataset: grades and statuses frozen from 1 Sep 2026 until two named non-employee raters join. Errata list and right-of-reply policy added. Steward-product disclosure field added, not yet populated. No grades moved. Migration script published beside the dataset.
